item.description:
• PhD Position in Montréal, Canada and Nantes, France
  • Two funded PhD positions on Epistemic AI (constraint programming or reinforcement learning) at TU Delft - deadline 28 February
  • Full professorship in Theoretical Computer Science at the University of Copenhagen
  • Postdoc position
  • Research Engineer on Constraint Programming
  • PostDoc Position in automated reasoning (Toulouse, France)
  • IMT ATLANTIQUE: tenured Full Professor position in Data and Decision Science
  • Positions available at Monash University (tenured and postdoc)
  • U. of Toronto Faculty Opening in Industrial Engineering: Machine Learning/AI/OR
  • Post-doc position in Nantes, France
